description: Find direct buses (Premium, City Direct, ShareTransport) in Singapore that stop near an office/destination. Give the office as office_area (a name or slug from list_areas, e.g. "Raffles Place", "one-north") or as office_lat/office_lng. Optionally give home as home_area (a neighbourhood like "Punggol") or home_lat/home_lng to keep only buses that pick up near home (within 1 km of home_lat/home_lng, or anywhere in the home_area neighbourhood). Returns up to 15 results with service number, type, operator, nearest stop, departure times, fare and the directbus.sg page URL.

home_area.description: Optional: home neighbourhood name or slug from list_areas, e.g. "Punggol", "ang-mo-kio". Use instead of home_lat/home_lng.

home_lat.description: Optional: latitude of home/pickup area. When provided, only buses that pick up within 1 km of home are returned.

home_lng.description: Optional: longitude of home/pickup area. Requires home_lat.

office_area.description: Office area name or slug from list_areas, e.g. "Raffles Place", "marina-bay". Use instead of office_lat/office_lng.

time_of_day.description: Optional: filter to morning (AM) or evening (PM) services.

name: find_direct_buses
title: Find direct buses
